correctness.rationale: An invertible linear change over F5 sends the ideal to (Q,T) independent of vertex t. Q is a nondegenerate conic and T is a product of three lines, meeting Q in six distinct rational points and therefore a reduced length-six scheme by Bezout. Coning gives precisely six concurrent components. Complete-intersection adjunction yields pa=4, normalization has six rational components and unique delta=9; the PGL2 action follows from the faithful S5 action on all six F5 conic points. The exact checker verified identities, counts, transversality and permutation action.
